info.title: Collab Docs API
info.description: REST API of the Collab Docs workspace. Document content is edited over WebSocket (CRDT).

accessToken.description: Access JWT, also set as the httpOnly cookie cd_at. Usable as a Bearer token.

parentId.description: Omit to create at the workspace root
null when the parent is hidden from the caller

documentCount.description: Live documents restored together with it

canRestore.description: Whether the caller may restore it

parentId.description: New parent; null moves to the root

beforeId.description: Place the document right before this sibling

afterId.description: Place the document right after this sibling

email.description: Must belong to a registered user

ticket.description: Short-lived (60 s) token for one WebSocket connection; fetch a new one per attempt.

wsUrl.description: Base URL for y-websocket; the provider appends `/<documentId>?ticket=<ticket>`. Closes: 4401 ticket invalid (fetch a new one), 4403 no access, 4404 not found, 4410 deleted, 4429 rate limited.

title.description: The document title when the snapshot was taken
The document title when the snapshot was taken

content.description: The content as sanitised ProseMirror JSON ({ type: "doc", content: [...] })

title.description: The document title when the snapshot was taken

flushed.description: false when the collaboration service could not write its buffer first, so the snapshot may miss the last seconds of editing

filename.description: Original file name; its extension has to belong to `mime`

fields.description: Form fields to send before the `file` part (the file must be the last field)

mode.description: VIEW publishes the page at /published/<slug>; EDIT lets anyone with the secret URL edit the document as a guest

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working; must lie in the future. Omitted or null: never.

token.description: EDIT links: the secret that goes into /edit-link/<token>. Shown once, only its hash is stored.

flushed.description: VIEW links: false when the collaboration service could not write its buffer first, so the page may miss the last few seconds of editing

expiresAt.description: The new expiry; null removes it

description.description: First 160 characters of the text, for the meta description

match.description: The part matches the query (to be highlighted)

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page

documentTitle.description: The title when the notification was created

excerpt.description: Start of the comment as plain text (never HTML)

ids.description: Notifications to mark as read; give this or `all`, not both. Ids that are not the caller’s are ignored.

all.description: Mark every notification of the caller as read

updated.description: Notifications that were unread and are read now

body.description: Empty when the comment was deleted. Plain text with `@[user id]` tokens.

mentions.description: The users the body mentions, with names

orphaned.description: The block is not in the document any more

body.description: Plain text, at most 4000 characters, shown as text and never as HTML. `@[<user id>]` mentions a user who can view the document; a mention of anyone else is removed and reported in `warnings`.

blockId.description: Id of the block the thread is about (the `id` attribute of the block in the document). Not checked against the stored content, which can be a few seconds behind the editor.

code.description: `MENTION_IGNORED`: the user does not exist or cannot view the document. `MENTION_LIMIT`: more than 20 mentions.

body.description: Plain text, at most 4000 characters, shown as text and never as HTML. `@[<user id>]` mentions a user who can view the document; a mention of anyone else is removed and reported in `warnings`.
Plain text, at most 4000 characters, shown as text and never as HTML. `@[<user id>]` mentions a user who can view the document; a mention of anyone else is removed and reported in `warnings`.

overLimit.description: Figures above the limits of the plan (after a downgrade). Existing content stays; creating more is refused with PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED until the figure is back under the limit.

checkoutUrl.description: Path of the page where the payment is made

requested.description: The provider was asked; the plan changes when its webhook event is applied

details.description: For `VALIDATION_FAILED`: one entry per invalid field. Other codes may add an object.

correlationId.description: The same id is returned in the `x-correlation-id` header.
